title: Giám định tổn thất và giải quyết bồi thường bảo hiểm

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the principles and procedures of insurance claims processing, including the analysis of losses and the preparation of claims reports.
Understand and apply legal regulations related to insurance claims and adjuster activities.
Analyze insurance contracts and understand the scope of coverage and exclusions.
Collect and analyze information relevant to claims and adjuster activities.
Apply critical thinking to evaluate claims and adjuster activities, including fraud detection.
Work effectively in teams and independently, demonstrating leadership and collaboration skills.
Solve problems related to insurance claims and adjuster activities, applying theoretical knowledge to practical situations.
Communicate effectively in both written and oral forms, presenting findings and reports.
Make ethical decisions in the context of insurance claims and adjuster activities.
Understand and apply risk management principles in the context of insurance claims and adjuster activities.
